title: Focus Expansion: Sharper Control (v4.0.0)
summary: CogniFocus expanded beyond a basic timer with Manual Block, smarter guidance, and stronger in-session control.
highlights: Manual Block adds stronger control outside sessions
Session objectives are visible and used in reactions
You can adjust a session mid-focus without restarting
improvements: Smarter focus guidance adds drift and burnout nudges
Planned Sessions were added to Pro
UI consistency, notification reliability, performance, and stability
